messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "to make swallowing easier, may open capsule"
set: ["to make swallowing easier, may open capsule", "if trouble swallowing, may open capsule", "can open the capsule if you have difficulty swallowing them", "do not crush, chew, break, or open capsule", "if you cannot swallow a capsule whole open it", "open capsule if child taking capsules for oral suspension", "capsules may be opened if difficulty swallowing", "if you cannot swallow an extended-release capsule whole, open it", "call your doctor if you have trouble swallowing a capsule or tablet", "do not open packet until ready to use", "swallow capsule whole", "if you cannot swallow a capsule whole, open it and mix the medicine with applesauce", "discard empty capsule", "you may be able to mix the medicine from a capsule with soft food", "body needs time to make own steroid hormones", "open package and peel back foil"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "if trouble swallowing, may open capsule",
    "can open the capsule if you have difficulty swallowing them",
    "if you cannot swallow a capsule whole open it",
    "capsules may be opened if difficulty swallowing",
    "if you cannot swallow a capsule whole, open it",
    "if you cannot swallow an extended-release capsule whole, open it",
    "open capsule if child taking capsules for oral suspension",
    "you may be able to mix the medicine from a capsule with soft food"
  ],
  "alias": "open capsule if difficulty swallowing"
}
